fusions.name: Closing Ring
fusions.desc: Whips the water into a ring that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 40% chance of [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Cinching Pull
fusions.desc: Snaps at a target carrying one of your afflictions, dealing 8 damage, using that affliction up and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Reed Fence
fusions.desc: Weaves a wall of reeds 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Caught Thread
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
